title: 15.18. Hetuduka, Atītattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetu atīto dhammo nahetussa naatītassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare nava …pe… upanissaye nava …pe… vigate nava.
Hetu anāgato dhammo nahetussa naanāgatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā upanissaye nava.
